sources.title: Introducing Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The August 5, 2026 launch identifies Muse Spark 1.2 as the newly available coding-focused update to 1.1 and describes expanded training and Muse Code co-training, without a direct parameter specification. Meta's October 15 PyTorch post links its August-release lineage statement to this exact page.

sources.title: Models — Meta Model API
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Lists muse-spark-1.2 among hosted Spark versions and separately lists Muse Spark Open with 816B total/42B active parameters; no direct count is printed in the hosted 1.2 section. The shared hosted specifications remain a 1,048,576-token context, text/image/video/audio/PDF inputs and text output.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.2 & Muse Code Evaluation Methodology
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and checked the full three-page PDF. Evaluates the exact Muse Spark 1.2 API model at xhigh effort with Muse Code and tool-using harnesses; no total or activated parameter column or count is provided.

sources.title: The Multimodal Intelligence of Muse Spark 1.2
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The August 20 follow-up explicitly discusses the forthcoming open-weights release of Muse Spark 1.2 and its existing visual and audio-video capabilities, but provides no counts. It does not describe new modalities being added when the weights are released.

sources.title: Meta Model API Terms of Service
sources.evidence: October 9 terms grant restricted service access, retain Meta's proprietary rights, and distinguish hosted API use from models obtained under separate open-weight licenses.

sources.title: Meta Model API Model Designation and Geographic Use Policy
sources.evidence: October 12 policy expressly designates Muse Spark 1.2 a Standard Model governed by the API terms; Contributor is separately named.

sources.title: Muse Spark Open Model Card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The Meta model card directly specifies Muse Spark Open at nominal 816B total/42B active and describes additional safety post-training for standalone use. The card itself does not name hosted 1.2; its connection is established by the developer lineage statements in s13-s15, rather than by the shared Spark name alone.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.3 Evaluation Report
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and searched the full 140-page October 23 report for parameter disclosures. It provides no total or active count for Muse Spark 1.2, including in comparisons; no evidence of a structural change between 1.2 and its open-weight safety-post-trained release was found here.

sources.title: Muse Wonder Model Card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and checked the full 13-page model card for later comparison disclosures. No total or active parameter count for exact Muse Spark 1.2 is provided.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.3 Evaluation Methodology
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and checked the full four-page methodology. It explicitly compares Muse Spark 1.2 at xhigh reasoning but provides no total or activated parameter column or count.

sources.title: Models.dev Muse Spark 1.2 record
sources.evidence: Original record inspected via raw GitHub; supplies catalog grouping and primary-source leads, but not independent proof of model facts.

sources.title: Reasoning — Meta Model API
sources.evidence: Describes native internal reasoning tokens for Muse Spark, mandatory reasoning, and effort controls; exact 1.2 support is separately confirmed by its evaluation methodology.

sources.title: Muse Spark Open — Meta developer model page
sources.evidence: Fetched directly with HTTP 200 and reopened October 27, 2026. Explicitly says Open derives from the Muse Spark model released in August with additional safety post-training. The August model is identified as 1.2 by its August 5 launch and, more explicitly, by s14-s15. No pruning, distillation, expert expansion or new modality is described for this conversion.

sources.title: Muse Spark Is Now an Open-Weights Model
sources.evidence: October 15, 2026 post, fetched directly with HTTP 200 and reopened October 27. Identifies Open as 816B total/42B active, describes additional safety post-training of the August release, and links that August release directly to the exact Muse Spark 1.2 launch (s1). It also says Open shares its base model with Spark 1.3. This is an original Meta-team statement, not independent reporting.

sources.title: TorchTitan Update: New SOTA Models, Performance at Scale, TitanRL
sources.evidence: October 21 post updated October 22, 2026; fetched directly with HTTP 200 and reopened October 27. Under the Muse Spark Open heading, the team calls it its MuseSpark 1.2 OSS release. This names the version explicitly and corroborates the dated 1.2-to-Open lineage. The section covers training efficiency and parallelism, with no statement that the released model was pruned, distilled, expanded or changed to a different routing architecture.

sources.title: Build with Muse Spark Open
sources.evidence: October 15, 2026 developer article reopened October 27. Explicitly specifies Open as an 816B-parameter sparse mixture-of-experts model activating roughly 42 billion parameters per token. This establishes the developer's approximate per-token active convention independently of total size; the article also describes existing text, image, video and audio input.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.2 — Meta developer model page
sources.evidence: Fetched directly with HTTP 200 and reopened October 27, 2026. Exact-model page describes coding and tool-use capabilities and a 1M context, but no total or active parameter specification.

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.1 Evaluation Report
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and searched the complete 112-page report as an earlier-generation cross-check. No total or active parameter count appears; this report is not the numerical basis for the 1.2 inference.

sources.title: Introducing Muse Spark Open, The Most Capable US Open-Weight Model to Date
sources.evidence: October 15 launch reopened October 27, 2026. Directly announces 816B total and 42B active for Open and identifies additional safety post-training. It does not itself name the August version, so exact 1.2 lineage comes from s13-s15.

name.note: Exact released display name and API identifier agree.

developer.note: Released by Meta; its API policy explicitly lists this model.

family.note: Muse Spark belongs to Meta's Muse line; retain the catalog's normalized muse family key.

release_date.note: Dated original announcement says the model is available that day; this is not the later Open checkpoint release.

open_weights.note: Hosted muse-spark-1.2 remains distinct from Muse Spark Open. The later downloadable checkpoint has a separate name and additional safety post-training; its release does not establish distribution of the exact hosted 1.2 weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the exact hosted Standard Model governed by Meta Model API Terms; the Muse Model License for Spark Open is not transferred.

parameters_b.note: Nominal 816B total inferred from explicit developer lineage: Meta identifies Spark Open as derived from its August release with additional safety post-training, its PyTorch post links that release to the exact 1.2 launch, and its later TorchTitan post names the Open model as the MuseSpark 1.2 OSS release. Open is directly specified at 816B; the checked primary sources disclose no structural change that would defeat the inference. This is a documented lineage inference, not a separately printed hosted-1.2 count or an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal approximately 42B active per token inferred from the same explicit 1.2-to-Open lineage and additional safety post-training. Meta separately states roughly 42B per token for Open, rather than deriving active size from total; no changed expert routing or other structural modification is disclosed in the checked lineage sources. This preserves Meta's nominal active convention and does not establish an exact component census for hosted 1.2. Fresh searches and later 1.3/Wonder reports supplied no direct 1.2 active-count table.

architecture.note: Mixture-of-experts architecture inferred from the explicit 1.2-to-Open developer lineage. Meta calls Open a sparse MoE and identifies additional safety post-training of the August 1.2 release; its later TorchTitan post explicitly names the 1.2 OSS release. No structural architecture change is disclosed. This supports the broad architecture classification, not a claim that every hosted component or deployment detail is separately documented.

context_window.note: The model documentation explicitly applies 1,048,576 tokens to all three listed hosted Spark versions, including 1.2.

modalities.note: Exact listed hosted version supports all five inputs and text output; docs specifically recommend 1.2 for audio. PDF denotes an accepted input format.

reasoning.note: Native model reasoning is supported: exact-model evaluations use xhigh, and API docs describe internal reasoning tokens.

tool_call.note: Exact-model launch describes co-training with Muse Code's toolset and sustained tool calls; API docs list tool calling for hosted Spark versions.

description.value: Muse Spark 1.2 is a coding-focused update to Muse Spark 1.1 with improvements in code generation, complex debugging, codebase understanding, and end-to-end developer workflows.
description.note: The existing description faithfully reflects the exact-model developer announcement.

patch.notes: Nominal 816B total, approximately 42B active per token, and MoE architecture are inferred from Meta's explicit identification of Spark Open as the August 1.2 release with additional safety post-training. These specifications are directly published for Open; no structural change is disclosed in that lineage. The exact hosted 1.2 weights and Open's weight license remain distinct.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit establishes nominal 816B total and approximately 42B active per token through newly located first-party lineage: Meta's Open developer page identifies the August parent; its PyTorch release links the exact 1.2 launch; and its October 21 TorchTitan post explicitly names the Open release MuseSpark 1.2. Meta describes additional safety post-training without a structural change. Counts are labeled lineage inferences, not direct hosted-endpoint specifications. Reopened launch/card/model pages and later evaluation PDFs, and searched separately for total and active disclosures; no later exact-1.2 numeric table was found. Updated the directly related architecture assessment to a labeled MoE lineage inference; preserved the remaining 11 field assessments.
